description: US Navy Bureau Number; mapped by Aerial Visuals at VFW Post 1621 Janesville alongside an AH-1F; not corroborated in a second source

TOS February 1968; 334th Armed Helicopter Company South Vietnam then Thailand and B Troop 7-17 Cavalry 101st Airborne; returned 1972 and served in South Korea with D Troop 7th Air Cavalry 4-7 Cavalry 45th Transportation and 128th Aviation; converted to AH-1S Modernized ca 1980 and redesignated AH-1F ca September 1988; deployed to Saudi Arabia for Desert Shield and Desert Storm August 1990 to February 1991; stored at Fort Drum by October 1998 and preserved at VFW Post 1621 Janesville by March 2002
